Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-pilot-context-fact

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-pilot-context-fact defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
authorization-context Authorization contextThe authorization fact available in the selected canonical projection, not a coverage or payer decision.
device-integrity-detail Device integrity detailSupported individual device/integrity source facts, not an aggregate verified-device conclusion.
source-integrity-status Source integrity statusThe preserved original canonical integrity status, including not_run; capability defaults are not results.
attestation-state Attestation stateThe original attestation state only when supported by selected immutable source facts, not inferred from capability.
attestation-basis Attestation basisThe supported verification or availability basis for the associated attestation state; no invented verifier.
tamper-state Tamper stateThe original supported upload/device tamper signal; advisory state is not cryptographic proof.
clock-skew Clock skewThe selected source clock-skew quantity in seconds; no substitution of a current preview for an older record.
clock-reference-at Clock reference timeThe trustworthy actual comparison reference time for the associated clock-skew measurement; not assembly time or an untrusted device clock.
firmware-version Firmware versionReported firmware version preserved for this selected source context, not current mutable Device state.
supervision-context Supervision contextSupported supervision segment/participant/time facts, not an automatic reconciled or billing outcome.
service-context Service contextThe original supported supervision service-context string, including rbt_direct_supervised_overlap when supplied.
planned-interval Planned intervalOne supported planned interval for the stated participant and source segment; never inferred from actual overlap.
observed-interval Observed intervalOne supported observed interval for the stated participant and source segment; not proof of planned compliance.
participant-role Participant roleThe original supported role string for the referenced participant, not an invented clinical credential.
comparison-status Comparison statusThe original supported supervision comparison status, not newly derived from XP.
source-reason Source reasonA supported sanitized reason associated with these same source facts; not a new outcome code.
authorization-number Authorization numberThe supported recorded authorization number, not a payer approval or unit allowance.
location-result Location resultThe specific supported location evaluation, not consent permission or collection applicability.
